experiment: E009 — Information value beyond the stopwatch (B1) for the 18 round-1 links
status_of_evidence: SECONDARY and NOT BLIND. The beyond-B2 results (E008) and raw correlations for these 18 links are already known, and B1 is nested in B2 (B2 = B1 + draft pick), so these results are partly predictable. Report them as a second column of the transfer map, not as new discoveries.
question: Beyond-B2 asks whether a tracking signature carries information the market (draft slot) had not already priced. Draft slot also reflects film and any other information clubs had, which may include tracking-derived evaluations. Beyond-B1 asks the narrower information question: does the tracking signature add anything beyond the traditional Combine stopwatch and measurements (plus position and draft year)?
links: Exactly the 18 links in experiments/results/E008.json (E002 P1-P3, E003 P1-P3, E004 P1-P3, E005 P1-P2, E006 P1-P3, E001 WR/DB/DL/OL), with the same features, targets, populations and expected signs as E008.
harness: bdb27.linkage.evaluate, protocol rev 3, with draft_controls=[] (baseline = position + draft-year dummies + COMBINE_CONTROLS), expected_sign as in E008, n_repeats=50, n_perm=2000, n_perm_fl=10000, seed 0 (seeds 1-2 when fl_p < 0.10).
multiplicity: BH across the 18 links (one family), reported next to E008's beyond-B2 column.
go: PLAN.md §4 rev 3 criteria 1-6 with B1 in place of B2; reported as 'information beyond the stopwatch', never as 'market inefficiency'.
prespecified_extras: leave-3-out for any link passing criterion 1
difference in partial r between B1 and B2 (how much the draft slot absorbs)
